description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations - Notify the Wages Board for the ceramics products Manufacturing Trade etc.,
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves regulatory matters under the Wages Boards Ordinance, specifically setting minimum wage rates and classifications for workers in the ceramics products manufacturing trade and the ice/aerated waters/fruit juice/jam manufacturing trade. It constitutes subsidiary legislation that establishes compliance requirements for these industries, falling clearly under Legal/Regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
